violation_type.title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee (26 TAC §746.1329(d))
violation_type.short_title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee
violation_type.typical_finding: One caregiver who the director stated received orientation during hire did not have documentation of the verified orientation.    This was corrected during inspection with the director and caregiver signing completion of orientation.

finding_variants.text: One caregiver who the director stated received orientation during hire did not have documentation of the verified orientation.    This was corrected during inspection with the director and caregiver signing completion of orientation.
Three caregivers have been placed in ratio in the classroom prior to having documented pre service training or documentation of two years of experience to be exempt from pre-service training.
Three caregivers did not have documentation for the 24 hours of Pre-service training.
Four employee records was lacking signatures for orientation for either the employee or trainer. This was corrected at inspection for each personnel file obtained the appropriate signatures.
Three out of five staff files evaluated did not have documented preservice training completed.  This was a recite.    The caregivers who were missing documented orientation had been corrected.
One caregiver does not have documented orientation on file. This was corrected at inspection with this being documented and added to their personnel record.
